facts:
## CELL FACTS

Cell 水_偏印 (Water carrying The Alchemist). Persona The Alchemist (偏印). Definition line: "Unconventional nourishment, the insight that transmutes". Keyword Insight, charge fierce, poles catalyst Vision / friction Distance. Family function: Mind. Cost dimension: nourishment that transmutes; fed on strange food, recipe unshareable. Arena: crucible, moon-side, distillation, the changed substance. Classical portrait: unorthodox absorption; solitary mastery; intake that starves output (枭神夺食). Ruled domains: Learning, Intuition, Solitude. Sibling (other polarity of the family): 正印.
Element arena: Water (depth, current, tide, rain, spring, flow). dm_element (which core reads this cell): Wood. structural_interaction seed: "Water generating Wood same-polarity — depth as nourishing source of reach".
- k2_overview: "Your Water moves as the Alchemist: depth studying itself. Knowledge does not sit in you, it dissolves, becoming a dark solution where fields merge and strange clarities precipitate. You understand what people have not said yet. The depth is real and isolating. Surface on a schedule, carrying one crystal at a time."
- k2_functional: "You think in solution: everything dissolved together until the pattern precipitates."
- adj_chips: {"catalyst":["Deep-diving","Tide-reading","Subtle"],"friction":"[REDACTED: the words under test]"}
- k2_domain_readings: {"Learning":"You learn by immersion: total absorption until a field saturates and understanding crystallizes whole. Interrupted immersion loses everything, so defend the deep dives. Come up between them.","Intuition":"Your intuition is sonar: reading what moves beneath speech, sensing the shape of the unsaid. It is uncannily accurate about people. Verify before acting. Sonar shows shape, never color.","Solitude":"Your solitude is the deep itself: home pressure, true thinking depth. The danger is forgetting the surface has weather worth feeling. Schedule the ascent. Bring someone a pearl."}
- fn_reading.friction.ledger (three rows, index-aligned to adj_chips.friction; authored order is significance order):
  - row 0: [REDACTED: the target row]
  - row 1: [REDACTED: the target row]
  - row 2: [REDACTED: the target row]
- Sibling cell 水_正印 chips (nothing you write may fit the sibling): {"catalyst":["Replenishing","Serene","Receptive"],"friction":["Passive","Waterlogged","Cocooned"]}
- Sibling cell 水_正印 friction row 0 drive passage, for the sibling test on the tension (this row must name a different either-or): "The current decides, and you call it flexibility. The job found you, the apartment happened, the relationship drifted into being and later drifted elsewhere. Choosing feels like swimming upstream, so you float, and your life is largely the record of where the water went."

Core element Wood, energy element Water. Law: Water feeds Wood (水生木: rain raises the forest). Relative to the core the energy is the feeder, so Water is this core's Mind. No chart is attached to this batch: the cell is written for every chart with a Wood core that shows Water on the friction pole, so no percentage and no state of one chart appears in any value. The friction pole of Water as the Mind is the Overfueled band's case (the core has more than it channels); tone by pole: reminder. Rows: row 0, row 1, row 2, each with its three angles (drive, cost_self, cost_others: the drive, the cost to the reader, the cost to others; the app shows one angle per row by position rotation, so each passage must stand alone); one chip per row, written once and copied byte-identical onto the row's three fields. The pair cell 木_水's definition and advice for this pole are rewritten in the same batch (the pair skeleton) and are withheld here; no four-word run may be shared with them, so keep every phrase the ledger's own.

value.text: You think a decision over long after it stopped needing thought. Water comes into you faster than you spend it, and one more angle feels like care rather than delay. You never get the lesson that only a made choice could give you.

value_b.text: You think every decision through one round too many. The thinking is the part you trust, and a thing you have understood feels finished to you whether you did it or not. Remember that you can understand a step completely without having taken it.

value.text: Thinking too much is your way of not being wrong. A wrong call scares you more than a late one, so you think a choice over past its day. Keep in mind that you lose chances this way without a sound, and sleep with them.

value.text: You keep what you know in until it is finished, and it never is. More goes into you than comes out, because a half-formed thought let loose feels like a thought lost. You guard your best ideas, and nobody ever gets to use them.

value_b.text: Taking in comes to you far more easily than letting out. Everything you learn goes into a store only you have the key to, since inside is where it stays safe. Bear in mind that what you keep in never gets to count.

value.text: You are hard to reach even from across the table. Most of you lives in an unfinished thought, and you would rather finish it than answer the person in front of you. You stay in your head and miss what was said to you.

value_b.text: Reaching you takes a while. Your thinking runs deeper than most conversations go, and you would rather stay down there than come up for small talk. Remember that your quiet feels like distance to anyone on the other side of it.

value.text: Being hard to reach keeps your thinking whole. An interruption costs you the thread, so you answer late or not at all rather than lose it. You already know that you trade closeness for that thread, and closeness does not wait.

value.text: Hard to reach means a thought is unfinished, and most of yours are. Finishing it comes ahead of the message, and you charge the person waiting in days. You leave them with less of you than they came for.
